project_context.description: CNC Takımhane Stok Takip Uygulaması. Designed for factory environments with high visibility, large touch targets for gloved or fast operation, and high-contrast dark blue/gray tones.

rules: No generic sans fonts like Inter for headings.
Use uppercase with wide tracking for table headers and overlines.
Increase base text size slightly to account for viewing distance in factory settings.
Maintain minimum 4.5:1 contrast for all text.
Never use pure black or pure white. Use slate-tinted equivalents.
Critical alerts must use semantic red to draw immediate visual attention.

layout_and_spacing.sidebar: w-72 border-r border-slate-800 bg-slate-950 hidden md:flex flex-col
layout_and_spacing.main_content: flex-1 bg-slate-900 overflow-auto p-6 md:p-8 lg:p-12
rules: Use 'Grid Borders' variant for dashboard widgets: flat background, 1px subtle border (border-slate-800).
Ensure all actionable areas (buttons, rows) are tall (h-14 to h-16) for easy touch operation.
Use grid-cols-1 on mobile, scaling to 4 columns on large screens for KPIs.

buttons.primary: h-14 px-8 rounded-lg font-bold text-lg transition-transform active:scale-95 shadow-lg shadow-blue-900/20
buttons.action_block: w-full h-24 md:h-32 rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800/50 hover:bg-slate-800 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all active:scale-95 cursor-pointer

cards.kpi: bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 p-6 rounded-xl flex flex-col gap-2

tables.wrapper: w-full overflow-auto rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800

forms.input: h-14 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-4 text-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent outline-none transition-all
forms.label: block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-400 mb-2 uppercase tracking-wide

badges.base: inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider border

rules: Stroke width: 2px for standard, 2.5px for large action blocks.
Do NOT use emoji icons under any circumstances.

login_background.usage: Use as a full-cover background image on the login screen with a heavy slate-950/80 overlay.

motion.transforms: Use 'active:scale-95' on large buttons for physical feedback.
rules: Avoid heavy animations. This is a functional toolroom app.
Focus on instant, reliable feedback (color change, slight press effect).
Add 'data-testid' to EVERY button, input, and table row.
Ensure focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500) are prominent.
Use redundant coding for status (e.g., Critical stock must have a Red color AND an Alert icon).

instructions_to_main_agent: This is an industrial factory floor application. Aesthetics must take a back seat to clarity, high contrast, and large touch targets.
Implement the theme primarily via standard Tailwind CSS slate and blue palette.
All copy MUST be in Turkish (e.g., 'Stok Giriş', 'Stok Çıkış', 'Kritik Uyarılar', 'Personel', 'Tezgah').
Use Phosphor or Lucide icons. Large 'action block' buttons on the dashboard for 'Stok Giriş' and 'Stok Çıkış' are mandatory for quick factory floor usage.
Table views must support filtering and be highly legible with h-16 row heights.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for cards or dropdowns. Solid slate-800 or slate-900 is required.
Avoid generic 'Inter' font. Import and use 'Chivo' for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text via Google Fonts.
For the login page, use the provided Unsplash image as a background with a heavy overlay, placing the login card in the center or left side.
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all) globally.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, selection states separate good from extraordinary.
